title: Common industry groups for comparing Australia with other economies
description: Sixteen groups that ANZSIC 2006 and ISIC Rev. 4 can both be summed to (docs/forward_plan_international_benchmarking.md, decision D-3). Each group is defined by ISIC Rev. 4 divisions: the classification the international sources use. The Australian side follows from the ABS correspondence (alicia.international.concordance). Each ANZSIC class goes to the group holding its ISIC matches, which is used for data published by class (business counts, company tax). 'anzsic_divisions' is the assignment for data published only by division (State Accounts output, Labour Force employment), and each division's fit is measured. 'stan' gives each group in the OECD STAN database as STAN activity codes with signs: real estate excludes the imputed rent of owner-occupied dwellings (L68A), which has no businesses or workers, and adds rental and leasing (N77), which ANZSIC puts with real estate. ISIC division 99 (extraterritorial organisations) is left out. 'sdbs' gives each group in the OECD's business demography and structural statistics (ISIC sections, with rental and leasing, N77, moved to real estate). 'naics' lists the US NAICS 2017 sectors used for the Census Bureau's Business Dynamics Statistics, with 'naics_note' where they differ. 'pmr' and 'stri' list the OECD product market regulation sector indicators and services trade restrictiveness sectors that apply to the group (labels checked against the OECD's SDMX codelists, 3 November 2026; the PMR's WATER is water transport).

groups.label: Manufacturing
groups.naics_note: NAICS puts machinery repair (811) in other services (81), as ANZSIC does.

groups.label: Electricity, gas, water and waste
groups.note: ANZSIC puts water supply, sewerage and waste in one division with electricity and gas; ISIC splits them into sections D and E.
groups.naics_note: NAICS puts waste management (562) in administrative services (56).

groups.label: Wholesale and retail trade
groups.note: ISIC has one trade section; ANZSIC splits wholesale and retail. ISIC also counts motor vehicle repair here, which ANZSIC puts in Other services.
groups.naics_note: NAICS puts motor vehicle repair (8111) in other services (81), as ANZSIC does.

groups.label: Information, media and telecommunications
groups.note: ISIC counts computer programming and consultancy (62) here; ANZSIC puts computer system design (7000) in professional services.
groups.naics_note: NAICS puts computer systems design (5415) in professional services (54), as ANZSIC does.

groups.label: Rental, hiring and real estate
groups.note: Real estate excludes the imputed rent of owner-occupied dwellings, which has no businesses or workers, and adds rental and leasing, which ISIC puts in administrative services.

groups.label: Professional, scientific, technical, administrative and support services
groups.note: Two divisions merged, as the OECD often does (STAN M_N), less rental and leasing.
groups.naics_note: Includes NAICS 55 (management of companies) and 56 (administrative and support, and waste management).

groups.label: Arts, recreation and other services
groups.note: Arts and recreation with personal and other services and private households. ANZSIC puts motor vehicle and machinery repair here; ISIC puts them in trade and manufacturing.
